moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026-2027 EFL Championship season officially begins today, Friday, August 14, with Wolverhampton Wanderers facing Blackburn Rovers in the opening match.

angles.name: Opening Whistle
angles.copy: The whistle blows! The 2026/27 EFL Championship season is officially underway today. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Welsh Teams Kicking Off
angles.copy: It's kick-off day for the Championship! And for Welsh fans, Wrexham play Cardiff City on Monday. Who are you rooting for?

moments.title: UK Heatwave Continues
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing its fifth heatwave of 2026, with temperatures hitting 38.1°C in London on August 13 and remaining high across central and southern England this weekend.

angles.name: Still Scorching
angles.copy: Another day, another scorcher! The UK heatwave continues, with temperatures still pushing high. Stay cool out there, Nation!

angles.name: Cool Down Tips
angles.copy: It's officially the UK's fifth heatwave of 2026! How are you staying cool and hydrated this weekend? Share your top tips!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament concludes with Finals Day on Sunday, August 16, 2026, at Lord's, featuring both the men's and women's finals.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday! Who will lift the trophy in the men's and women's competitions at Lord's?

angles.name: One Hundred Balls
angles.copy: The Hundred reaches its climax this weekend! Get ready for a day of explosive cricket as the finals play out on Sunday.

moments.title: FA Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield, contested by Arsenal and Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16, due to Wembley's unavailability.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Community Shield
angles.copy: Big football coming to Cardiff! The Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal vs Manchester City in the FA Community Shield this Sunday.

angles.name: Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The Premier League season is almost here! But first, it's the Community Shield this Sunday, with Arsenal taking on Manchester City in Cardiff.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Madonna!
moments.blurb: Pop icon Madonna, known for hits like 'Like a Virgin' and 'Vogue', celebrates her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: The one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna, turns 68 this Sunday! What's your all-time favourite track from the Material Girl?

angles.name: Celebrate Madonna
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the legendary Madonna this weekend! Still influencing generations. What's her most iconic look?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Belinda Carlisle!
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 on Monday, August 17, 2026.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Birthday
angles.copy: Heaven is a place on Earth... and it's Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday this Monday! What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo hit?

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating an 80s icon! Belinda Carlisle turns 68 on Monday. From The Go-Go's to 'Circle in the Sand', her voice defined an era.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Robert Plant!
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman and acclaimed solo artist Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday on Thursday, August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, this Thursday! What's your ultimate Zep track?

angles.name: Stairway to 78
angles.copy: The golden god of rock, Robert Plant, turns 78 on August 20th. Celebrate the rock legend with us!

moments.title: Premier League Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: New Season Hype
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st. Who's your pick for the title this season?

angles.name: Opening Match Focus
angles.copy: Defending champions Arsenal take on Coventry City next Friday as the Premier League season begins! Are you ready for the drama?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: London's All Points East Festival starts on Friday, August 21, and runs until August 30 in Victoria Park, featuring headliners like Tyler, The Creator and Lorde.

angles.name: Festival Vibes London
angles.copy: Victoria Park, get ready! All Points East kicks off next Friday with an incredible lineup. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Summer Festival Season
angles.copy: All Points East is back next week! Ten days of amazing music in London's Victoria Park. Your summer soundtrack is sorted.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', turns 31 on Saturday, August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating a pop powerhouse! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday. What's the track that gets you dancing every time?

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to Dua Lipa this weekend! From 'New Rules' to 'Dance The Night', she's consistently delivering pop perfection.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Rick Springfield!
moments.blurb: Singer, songwriter, and actor Rick Springfield, famous for 'Jessie's Girl', turns 77 on Sunday, August 23, 2026.

angles.name: Jessie's Girl Birthday
angles.copy: Still looking for a girl like Jessie's Girl? It's Rick Springfield's 77th birthday this Sunday! What's your favourite 80s power pop anthem?

angles.name: Rock Star Actor
angles.copy: Happy 77th to the multi-talented Rick Springfield on Sunday! From his music to his acting roles, he's a true entertainer.
